ekyc.title: Verify your identity
ekyc.lede: Complaints go to a real official, so we check once that you are a real person.
ekyc.demoNotice: Demonstration e-KYC. This prototype is not connected to UIDAI or DigiLocker: real Aadhaar OTP verification needs a licence this project does not have. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere, the number is never stored (only its last 4 digits), and the OTP is shown on screen instead of being sent by SMS.
ekyc.name: Name as on your Aadhaar
ekyc.aadhaarHelp: For the demo, use a specimen number such as 2341 2341 2346.
ekyc.consent: I consent to ElectraLens checking my identity for filing complaints. I understand only my name, the last 4 digits and the date are kept.
ekyc.otpSent: An OTP would be sent to the mobile number linked to Aadhaar ending {last4}.
ekyc.production: In production this step would use DigiLocker’s Aadhaar e-KYC through a registered partner integration, with the citizen’s consent on DigiLocker itself.

new.title: Raise a complaint
new.lede: Describe your problem to the assistant in your own words. It will ask a few questions and draft the complaint for you. Check the draft, choose the area and file it.
